mapper.sql: id, aggregate_type AS aggregateType, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, event_type AS eventType, schema_version AS schemaVersion, exchange_name AS exchangeName, routing_key AS routingKey, payload::text AS payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, locked_at AS lockedAt, last_error AS lastError, created_at AS createdAt, published_at AS publishedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_outbox_event ( id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, schema_version, exchange_name, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{schemaVersion}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSONB), 'PENDING', 0, COALESCE(#{nextRetryAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM mq_outbox_event WHERE ( status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_at < #{lockExpiredBefore} ) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE mq_outbox_event target SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL FROM candidates WHERE target.id = candidates.id RETURNING target.id, target.aggregate_type AS aggregateType, target.aggregate_id AS aggregateId, target.event_type AS eventType, target.schema_version AS schemaVersion, target.exchange_name AS exchangeName, target.routing_key AS routingKey, target.payload::text AS payload, target.status, target.retry_count AS retryCount, target.next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, target.locked_at AS lockedAt, target.last_error AS lastError, target.created_at AS createdAt, target.published_at AS publishedAt
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox_event SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, locked_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE mq_outbox_event SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxPublishRetries} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'FAILED' END, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, locked_at = NULL, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
